title: Sure as the Morning
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who goes looking and keeps looking, and tonight Hosea says we will know the Lord if we follow on to know Him. Pressing his nose to the cold window and watching the whole sky turn pink, then telling everyone the sun came back again, is exactly Scout’s way of finding out that morning always keeps its promise.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because he loves to go looking and finding. In Scout’s world today: Scout woke before anyone else and pressed his nose to the cold window to watch the sky turn pink. He watched the whole thing. At breakfast he told everyone the sun came back again. Just like the people who learned Heavenly Father comes as sure as the morning, Scout learned that morning always keeps its promise.
